tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Use this when a destination name is ambiguous or a traveller asks which countries or regions are in the eSIM catalogue. Resolve the name, alias or country code to matching comparison pages. A known country can go directly to compare_plans.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Use this when a traveller wants to compare travel eSIM prices for one country or region. Supply the trip length and minimum total data, or unlimited data. Optional filters cover hotspot use, a phone number and preferred published currency. For a list of countries that one plan must cover, use route_

tools.name: plan_details
tools.description: Use this when a traveller asks about a particular eSIM plan's networks, countries, validity, hotspot, phone number or fair-use terms. Look up its plan_id, preferably the provider-qualified ID returned by compare_plans or route_plans. Report only the details published for that plan.

tools.name: carrier_roaming
tools.description: Use this when a traveller names their home carrier and wants to know whether land roaming is included or what a roaming pass costs in a destination country. Returns published rules by eligible plan and a 7-day, 3 GB eSIM benchmark where available. It cannot check the traveller's account.

tools.name: phone_esim_support
tools.description: Use this when a traveller asks whether their exact phone model supports eSIM. Include the country or region where the phone was bought when known. Return the manufacturer's evidence for that variant and flag missing or conflicting evidence.

tools.name: pocket_wifi
tools.description: Use this when a traveller wants to rent a portable Wi-Fi hotspot in one country. Returns up to 10 pocket Wi-Fi offers ordered by published daily rates where available. Rental dates, fees and minimum stays can affect the total. For tethering from a phone on an eSIM, use compare_plans.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Use this when a traveller asks which mobile network has outdoor signal in a supported country, place or road route. Returns regulator-modelled coverage and, where available, priced eSIMs listing the leading network. Omit place for national coverage. US speed tiers in Mbps down/up are 5/1 for 4G and

tools.name: route_plans
tools.description: Use this when a traveller needs one eSIM that covers every country on an itinerary. Pass up to 12 countries and any stated trip length and minimum total data. Results use published prices in the site's currency order. For outdoor signal along a road, use coverage.
